effect.name: Posterize
effect.description: Snaps every channel to a fixed number of steps. Four levels is roughly what an 8-bit console gave you; two is a woodcut. Pair it with Dither if the banding gets ugly.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Levels
parameter.description: Steps per channel. 2 is one bit per channel, 4 gives the classic retro banding.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the banded result back over the original.

parameter.name: Luminance Only
parameter.description: On, only brightness is stepped and the hue stays smooth. Off, each channel is stepped on its own.
